title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 15
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: tài khoản tiết kiệm, video đào tạo, cải tạo khách sạn, sơn nhà, học bổng, đặt món trực tuyến, hành lý thất lạc, bánh kem, bảo tàng, ngân hàng thực phẩm, xe điện scooter, khu nghỉ dưỡng, thư viện cho mượn dụng cụ, nhà nổi, spa, làn xe đạp, khoá tin học, khách sạn, thuê xe chung; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

City Plans to Replace Main Street Parking with Bike Lanes

FAIRFIELD (April 2) – The Fairfield City Council has approved a plan to remove 60 parking spaces on Main Street and replace them with protected bike lanes. Construction will begin in June and is expected to be completed by September.

Council member Ray Diaz said the change will make cycling safer and encourage more people to visit downtown shops by bicycle. To make up for the lost spaces, the city will open a new 200-space parking garage on Elm Street, two blocks from Main Street, in August.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To the Editor:

I own Lena's Bookshop on Main Street, and I am concerned about the city's plan to remove the parking spaces in front of our shops. Many of my customers are older people who cannot walk long distances or ride bicycles.

The new garage on Elm Street is a good idea, but it will not open until August, two months after construction begins. During that time, my customers will have nowhere nearby to park. I hope the city will consider waiting until the garage opens before removing any spaces.

Lena Morris
Fairfield
